avatar_decoration.description: The owner's avatar decoration (border effect) PICK as a decoration key — `legendary`, `epic`, `none` (an explicit no-border), `achievement:<id>` — never a url: the client owns the key -> artwork catalog. For the owner's chooser (which tile is selected); the border to draw is resolved_avatar_decoration. null or absent means no pick. Served on GET /users/{id} and POST /users/batch rows; absent on rows cc did not produce

resolved_avatar_decoration.description: The border to draw on this avatar, resolved from the owner's pick and achievements (TASK-6093): the pick while still earned, else the rarest tier ring the achievements earn (`legendary`, `epic`); null means no border (an explicit `none` pick, or nothing earned). Same key grammar as avatar_decoration. Served on GET /users/{id} and POST /users/batch rows — never fetch a user's achievements to draw a border. Absent on rows cc did not produce. A newly earned tier can take up to an hour to show to other viewers; the owner's own view updates immediately

entry_id.description: The squad's entry id (UUID); '' until cc serves it, so gate on a non-empty value

active_competition_entry.description: Squads only: the squad’s entry in the group competition whose registration is open or which is running (the earliest-starting one when several are); phase = registration before the start, live once it runs. null = the squad is not entered, or the account is a person. Absent on cached rows written before the field shipped: treat absent as null. Also null when cc’s competition read failed open: never render null as a confirmed non-entry.

last_username_update_timestamp.description: Unix epoch ms of the last username change; null when never renamed. Served by the single-profile read and on labelled-wallet search rows; absent from batch and hydrated search-v2 rows (cc batch profile read omits it, TASK-4734)

last_active_at.description: ISO time of the account's latest authenticated request (~1 min granularity, kept for one day). Viewer-relative: served on GET /users/{id} and POST /users/batch rows to a signed-in viewer, for accounts the viewer follows and the viewer's own row, null otherwise (not followed, never seen, degraded read) — render null as unknown. Absent for anonymous callers, on the API host, and on every other row-serving read (TASK-4935)

role.description: cc's GroupRole name, an upstream-owned open set: render unknown values as a plain member (TASK-4734). Known values: OWNER, ADMIN, MEMBER, UNSPECIFIED

890664.competitionEntryPhase.description: registration before the competition starts, live once it runs. Known values: registration, live

comparison: Exact selected AST alpha comparison; loop/catch/function scopes, operators, declarations, calls and order preserved. Imported call targets and boolean spellings normalize.
boundaries: React/compiler memoization, the 500ms debounce scheduler and useInfiniteQuery runtime are not executed/reconstructed.
queryOptions.enabled is a runtime input; calling queryFn directly still performs its request, including for short/disabled terms.
Declared response is array(userRow), including optional string wallet_label; the client consumes raw JSON and classifies wallet_label by presence. No schema rewrite or server compatibility claim.
profiles.read is captured publicRead metadata, not proof of live server scope enforcement or current authentication.
